title: BioVAT alignment_qc pipeline parameters
description: Quality checks of alignments with samtools flagstat, Riker and Qualimap

input_options.title: Input options
input_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data.

samplesheet.description: Alignments samplesheet (CSV) with the columns sample, library_id, platform, single_end, alignment and index. library_id is needed at the library and markdup levels and can be empty otherwise.

level.description: Level at which the alignments were produced. It is the prefix of the output files. Required.

alignments.description: Alternative to --samplesheet: a YAML or JSON file with one entry per alignment. Fields: meta (a map with id, pl, single_end and, depending on the level, read_group or library), alignment (BAM/CRAM file) and index (its index). Use either --samplesheet or --alignments.

fasta.description: Reference fasta file. Needed by Riker and to decode CRAM.

fai.description: Fai index of the reference fasta. Used by Riker. Created from --fasta when it is needed and not given.

alignment_qc_options.title: Alignment QC options
alignment_qc_options.description: Tools to run on the alignments. samtools flagstat always runs.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
